champions-reg-mc.label: Champions Reg M-C
champions-reg-mc.notes: Current ban-only format (as of Sep 9, 2026): all Legendary, Mythical, and Paradox Pokémon are banned (0 Restricted slots). Adds newly usable Pokémon and Mega Evolutions over Reg M-B (including Z Mega Evolutions). Bundled ban list is curated from species flags + Paradox identities — still confirm against the official Champions roster before events. This lab is not an official event legality authority.

champions-reg-ma.label: Champions Reg M-A
champions-reg-ma.notes: Ban-only format: all Legendary, Mythical, and Paradox Pokémon are banned (0 Restricted slots). Mega Evolution reintroduced (59 species). Uses the same curated Champions ban list as Reg M-C — confirm before events. This lab is not an official event legality authority.

champions-reg-mb.label: Champions Reg M-B
champions-reg-mb.notes: Ban-only format, same base as Reg M-A: all Legendary, Mythical, and Paradox Pokémon are banned (0 Restricted slots). Superseded by Reg M-C for ranked play after Sep 9, 2026. Uses the curated Champions ban list — confirm before events. This lab is not an official event legality authority.

regulation-i.label: Regulation I
regulation-i.notes: Up to 2 Restricted Pokémon per team. Lists follow official Scarlet/Violet Regulation I (May–Aug 2025).

regulation-j.label: Regulation J
regulation-j.notes: Placeholder ruleset — legality mirrors Regulation I until official Regulation J lists are published.

regulation-h.label: Regulation H
regulation-h.notes: Ban-only format: Paradox Pokémon, Treasures of Ruin, Legendary and Mythical Pokémon are not allowed. Most other Paldea, Kitakami, and Blueberry dex Pokémon are legal.
